result.target: log1p(copper concentration in mg/kg), measured soil at 0–5 cm
result.scope: Research interpolation of 0–5 cm soil copper in the conterminous United States, using historical USGS samples.
limitations: Shallow soil chemistry does not establish ore, reserves, recoverability, or deep mineralization.
Global cells outside the observations and all deeper unmeasured volumes remain unknown.
Five-degree blocks reduce spatial leakage but adjacent blocks can remain correlated; this is not a geographic extrapolation test.
The bootstrap interval measures aggregate score variability by block; it is not calibrated uncertainty for any location.
The audit is consumed once. Further method selection needs a genuinely new independent evaluation design, not another hash seed.
This is one constrained model-selection experiment, not proof of autonomous scientific discovery or recursive research-policy improvement.
